hooks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $g='C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $g)) { $g='git' }; & $g add -A 2>$null | Out-Null; & $g diff --cached --quiet 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 1) { & $g commit -m 'otomatik revize' 2>$null | Out-Null; & $g push origin main 2>$null | Out-Null }
